name: kiln-checkpoint-smoke
description: Auto-mode test: a checkpoint (branch + approval) that PAUSES when its name is in .kiln/config.json review_checkpoints, and SKIPS in autonomous mode (empty checkpoints). Mirrors kiln-build-prd's checkpoint pattern.

steps.condition: if grep -q test-gate .wheel/outputs/cfg.json; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi

steps.message: Checkpoint test-gate reached — approve to continue.

steps.command: echo 'reached the end past the checkpoint' > .wheel/outputs/completed.txt; cat .wheel/outputs/completed.txt
